scenes.say: Tomorrow at nine, the branch meets. This is what will already be on the screen.
None of it gets typed up in the morning. It has been building all week, by itself.
Your day arrives every morning with your goal, and the one thing to do first.
Tomorrow's ask is on it. Bring a case that worked. A point you can teach. A question. Or say where you need help.
You tap it once, and it lands on the agenda under the right item, before anybody sits down.
At half past eight, press the button that says I am here. That tap is the register.
First on the board. Since the first of October, 60 applications, and 72 policies picked up.
Fact finds. 157 so far this year. 11 of them this month.
Then what we are about to lose. 121 renewals and premiums due. 32 pendings. 352 service requests open.
And we closed 267 of them in the last seven days.
The campaign. 318 orphan files still open, every one of them with a name against it.
Then the room has it. An agent shows what worked. One of us teaches. The floor is open.
Each unit closes with its own number. Every action carries a name, and next week opens on it.
Nineteen of us, at nine o'clock. Everything else is already there.
